episode_event_8070_zagirl_and_gai/4001_1:
I heard Pasio’s an artificial island, but it’s
surprisingly lush!
Maybe it helps the Pokémon relax.

Could be why all the Pokémon here seem
so comfortable!
I hope Feraligatr and Meganium like it here.

All right, a new town means lots to explore.
Let’s go sightseeing!

Yeah! I wanna check out the cafés and see
what’s on the menu.

Good thinking. It’s important to find spots to
take it easy!
Excuse me! Could I ask for directions?
Huh?
Do you know which way the arena is?

I’m supposed to participate in a Pokémon
tournament, but it seems I’ve gotten lost.
I’m worried I won’t make it in time.
Oh no! That’s awful...

We only just arrived on Pasio, so we don’t
actually know—
Sure. We’ll show you the way.
Really? That’d be a big help!
Urbain... Are you sure?

Yeah! As long as we’ve got our Poryphones,
we’ll figure it out!

I guess since we’ve got a map, we should
be OK...

And we can’t just turn a blind eye when
someone needs help.
Exactly.

We protected Lumiose City, as members of
Team MZ.
So let’s help people on Pasio, too!
episode_event_8070_zagirl_and_gai/6801_1:
Looks like there are lots of people on this
island who could use our help!

Let’s do our best to help the people and
Pokémon on Pasio, too!

Yeah. We’ll show ’em what Team MZ’s
leader and secret weapon can do!
episode_event_8070_zagirl_and_gai/4002_1:
According to my Poryphone, you should be
good if you continue down this street.
Thank you, both!
I think I’ll make it to the tournament on time!
I’m happy we could help!
Oh! There you are, Leon. What a relief!

You never showed up, so Hop was looking
for you.

Leon? You mean, like, THE Leon?! The super
strong Trainer from Galar?!
We’ve heard of you!
Hahaha! It’s an honor!
You’re both from Lumiose City in Kalos, right?
Serena and Calem here are from Kalos, too!
Oooh, Lumiose, huh?

Wow. I didn’t think we’d meet anyone here
from the same region.
We have lots of memories from Lumiose, too.

There are way more wild zones lately—but
some people aren’t too happy about that.
What do you two think?
Uh... What’s a wild zone?
You don’t know?!

I feel like if you’ve been to Lumiose, it’s hard
NOT to have seen a wild zone.

You know, Serena and Calem are incredible
Trainers.

You’ll be battling in today’s tournament too,
won’t you?
Yup! With all our friends!

If you’re that confident, maybe we’ll face
you in the Z-A Royale someday.
The...Z-A Royale?
Huh? You don’t know about that either?
Weird. How could that be?
Oh. Maybe...
Yeah. I had the same thought.

This is just a theory, but we might be from
different versions of Lumiose.
Different versions?

On Pasio, some people and Pokémon are
from other worlds or eras.
So your Lumiose may be different from ours.
It’s possible.

I know people who’ve experienced
something similar.
That’s wild...

As members of Team MZ, we’ve handled
some strange, otherworldly requests.

I guess that makes your theory easier to
believe!
Yeah, anything’s fair game!

By the way, Leon, we’ve been talking for
a while. Are you OK on time?
Yikes! I’d better get going!
Let’s hurry!
episode_event_8070_zagirl_and_gai/4003_1:
The group managed to lead Leon to the
arena—albeit slightly behind schedule.
But when they arrived, it was chaos...
They treat people and Pokémon horribly.

They often threaten and steal from others
without a second thought.
What in the world are they doing here?
Wait! Look who else is there!

You’re the ones who snuck into my lab and
stole my data, aren’t you.

If so, then why kidnap me? This hardly
seems necessary.
Heh heh! Look at you, trying to act tough!

It’s true. We—Team Rocket—stole your
Mega Evolution research!

And thanks to it, we threw together
something...interesting.

Now you’re gonna help us improve our
machine.
episode_event_8070_zagirl_and_gai/4004_1: It can’t be...

You can’t just force Pokémon to
Mega Evolve!
Wahahaha! Unbelievable, huh?

They induced Mega Evolution without a
Key Stone OR a Mega Stone?!
I bet they’re misusing sync stones.

Sync stones? Are those the things embedded
in our Poryphones?

Yeah. They’re mysterious stones that turn
sync pairs’ bonds into real power.

They can induce other phenomena, too—like
Mega Evolution.

Seriously? I didn’t know they could do
all THAT...

Usually, Mega Evolution only occurs when a
Trainer has a Key Stone...

and it resonates with a Mega Stone held by
their Pokémon.

On top of that, the Trainer and Pokémon
need to have a strong bond.

Right. That’s how a Pokémon can temporarily
unleash its hidden power.

It gives them a strength boost even greater
than Evolution.

A strong bond is essential when
Mega Evolving via sync stones, too.

But it’s hard to believe Team Rocket could
form such bonds.

What about Mega Evolution requiring
no bond?
Team Rocket’s leader—Giovanni!
Let Professor Sycamore go!
That won’t be happening.

My goal is for all my subordinates to taste
the power of Mega Evolution.

That is why I developed a device that allows
Mega Evolution without bonds.

But it remains unstable. Professor Sycamore’s
assistance will prove indispensable.

But Mega Evolving Pokémon that way only
makes them suffer!

Yeah! This is just Rogue Mega Evolution all
over again!
Rogue Mega Evolution...?

Yeah. When a wild Pokémon is affected by
lots of Mega Power...

it can Mega Evolve against its will. We call
it Rogue Mega Evolution.
Oh?

We in Team MZ were in charge of calming
down Rogue Mega-Evolved Pokémon.

So we won’t let you get away with your
forced Mega Evolution schemes, either!
Everyone! We have to stop Team Rocket!
Of course! I can’t ignore something so vile!
episode_event_8070_zagirl_and_gai/4005_1:
Impressive work from Galar’s Champion—
except for one detail.

It appears you’ve forgotten about poor
Professor Sycamore over here. We can’t
have that, now, can we?
Urk...
He’s using the professor as a human shield!
Now Leon’ll have trouble giving his all...

This is bad. At this rate, they’ll totally
overpower us!

So many Trainers and Mega-Evolved
Pokémon...

Hey, Urbain! Don’t you think this is kinda the
norm for us?
Huh? What do you mean?
It’s like the Z-A Royale!

Back in Lumiose, we beat lots of Trainers
all at once, right?

When you put it like that...I see what
you mean.
I’ve got an idea.
Gotcha. Good idea!
You two—hear us out.
Got it. Let’s go with that.
We can definitely make that work!
All right, Urbain. I’m ready!
OK. It’s go time.
As Team MZ always does...
...Let’s help people and Pokémon!
Cut it out, Team Rocket!
How dare you toy with others! Enough!
Finally getting desperate, are we?
Did you forget we have a hostage?

Any more lip from you and the professor will
be in for a world of hurt!

No more dirty tricks! Just battle us fair and
square!

Heh heh heh... This is what happens when
you come for Team Rocket!
When did you get behind us?!

Try looking somewhere other than straight
ahead!
Are you OK?
You saved my skin. Thank you!
All right! Our plan worked!
We’ll get the professor somewhere safe!
S-stop right there!
Hey! I wouldn’t look away if I were you!
episode_event_8070_zagirl_and_gai/4006_1: I shall use all my might, then.

Sorry, Charizard. You did well toughing
it out for this long.

But how?! That Mega Evolution wasn’t
forced!
Team Rocket has bonds too, you know.
Do you really think that’s stronger?

C’mon! Let’s show him the true strength of
Team MZ’s leader and secret weapon!
Let’s do it, too. Meganium, Mega Evolve!
episode_event_8070_zagirl_and_gai/4007_1:
That’s a surprise... I’ve never seen those
forms before!
It’s time you accept your fate!
As long as Team MZ’s here...

we won’t let you torment anyone—person
or Pokémon!
There are many facets to Mega Evolution.

I’ll withdraw for now. I’ve already learned
about something fascinating—this “Rogue
Mega Evolution” you spoke of.

Now I see a future for our forced
Mega Evolution.
episode_event_8070_zagirl_and_gai/4008_1: Sorry for the tournament’s late start!
You all know how Team Rocket can be!

But thanks to these courageous Trainers,
Harmony and Urbain...
Care to show me your strength head-on?
That’s what I like to hear!
Everyone, let’s have a champion time!
episode_event_8070_zagirl_and_gai/4009_1: After the tournament...
Wow, a lot happened today, huh?

Yeah. We’d only planned to do a little
sightseeing.

I can’t believe we battled an organization
that’s misusing Mega Evolution.

It’s not just Team Rocket who does that sort
of thing, you know.

You just...don’t know when another danger
will pop up?

Urbain, I think I wanna stay on Pasio for a
little while.
If another problem arises, I wanna help!
That’s funny—I was thinking the same thing.
Aw, that’d be a huge help!

This works out well. I wanted you two to tell
me more about Mega Evolution!
All right! We made some new friends, so...

We should celebrate! I’ll treat everyone to
Hotel Z’s signature dish—croissant curry!
Curry, huh? Sounds great!
Croissant curry...?
I can’t imagine such a dish.
Is it well known in your version of Lumiose?
*giggle* Uh, not exactly...
You’ll understand when you try it!

Just you wait—I’ll make it popular here on
Pasio, too!
